parole.testo: From Iranian, more specifically possibly from Alanic *ærzæ. Compare Ossetian ӕрзӕ́ (ærzǽ), Persian هزار (hezâr). The Iranian word is from Proto-Indo-Iranian *saȷ́ʰásram, from Proto-Indo-European *ǵʰéslom. The Permic languages have also borrowed this numeral from Indo-Iranian, compare Komi-Zyryan сюр
